## Design of the experiment

The data generating mechanism is designed completely similar as in the experiment with gamma-distributed data. 
Two additional parameters are introduced: the limits of detection (LoD) for the non-reference method ($L_x$, expressed as a quantile of the latent variable from which we simulate) and the ratio between the limits of detection of the reference and non-reference method ($L_y = r_{LoD}\times L_x$, default ratio equal to 1).

If the observed data (after addition of measurement error) fall below the LoD then they are censored and we observe the tuple $\tilde{x}_{\text{obs},i} = max(x_{\text{obs},i}, L_x), \delta^x_i = I(x_{\text{obs},i} \leq L_x)$ (0 for uncensored observations, 1 for censored). We observe the same tuple for the reference method: $\tilde{y}_{\text{obs},i}, \delta^y_i$.

An example dataset is shown below (on the log-scale). For the observations that fall below the LoD on either the $x$- or $y$-axis we don't get to see the actual value and we use them only for visualization purpose here.

```{r}
#| label: example 
#| fig-cap: Example of left-censored soil descriptor (censoring in outcome and predictor).

source(here("source/R/simulate-data-leftcens.R"))

set.seed(1)
data_list <- sim_data_leftcens(
  mu_x = 1, cv_x = .5, quantile_lodx = .1
)
data_df   <- tibble(
  x_obs    = data_list$x_obs,
  y_obs    = data_list$y_obs,
  x_obs_c  = data_list$x_obs_c,
  y_obs_c  = data_list$y_obs_c,
  x_obs_ci = data_list$x_obs_ci,
  y_obs_ci = data_list$y_obs_ci
)

lod <- data_list$lodx

p <- ggplot(data_df, aes(x_obs, y_obs, color = interaction(x_obs_ci, y_obs_ci))) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lod, lty = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = lod, lty = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(.8, .3)) +
  labs(x = "reference method", y = "non-reference method",
       color = "left-censoring:\npredictor.outcome")
ggExtra::ggMarginal(p)
```



```{r}

mod <- cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(
  here("source/stan-leftcens/gammareg-leftcens.stan")
)

fit <- mod$sample(
  data = data_list,
  chains = 4,
  parallel_chains = 4
)

draws <- fit$draws(
  variables = c("mu_x", "cv_x", "beta0", "beta1", "shape")
) |> posterior::as_draws_df()

pairs(draws[, 1:5])

ppred_draws <- fit$draws() |> 
  posterior::as_draws_df() |> 
  select(contains("y_new_rep"))

spc <- tibble(
  .name  = c(
    paste0("y_new_rep[",1:1000,"]_est"),
    paste0("y_new_rep[",1:1000,"]_ll"),
    paste0("y_new_rep[",1:1000,"]_ul")
  ),
  .value = c(rep(c("est","ll","ul"), each = 1000)),
  id = rep(1:1000, 3)
)

prediction_summary <- ppred_draws |> 
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(), 
      list(est = mean, ll = ~quantile(.x, .025), ul = ~quantile(.x, .975))  
    )
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer_spec(spc) |> 
  cbind(yobs = data_list$y_obs_c_val)

set.seed(1)
prediction_summary |> 
  slice_sample(n = 50) |> 
  ggplot(aes(yobs, est, ymin=ll, ymax=ul)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, lty = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = lod, lty = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = lod, lty = 2)

```
